title: AI-Generated Content Labeling Isn't a Global Rule (Yet)
content:
Did you know… 🤓

…that some countries now require by law that AI-generated text be labeled as such?

Starting in August 2026, the EU AI Act will require visible labeling whenever content appears to be human-created but is largely generated by AI. In China, similar labeling rules have been in place since September 2025!

Unfortunately, there is currently no global standard, which means that the rules can vary greatly from country to country. So if you publish AI-generated content on your WordPress site, you should definitely check what regulations apply where your readers are located.
